Weaver: USA Gypsum is dedicated to establishing environmentally and economically sound principles that advantage all our stakeholders. We also are committed to the Three Pillars, the triple bottom line of social prosperity, environmental friendliness and profitability.

What is the biggest misconception you think your business partners have about or related to us being "green"?
Weaver: Some organizations believe that sustainability means the same thing as "green," and it does not. Business partners often misunderstand that switching to green products alone is enough.
